title: CREATE SERVER PRO
description: A massive Create-focused technology and engineering modpack for Minecraft, featuring advanced automation, trains, aircraft, logistics systems, and high-performance optimization for smooth gameplay.
body:
This modpack is built around the Create mod ecosystem, expanding it into a full-scale engineering, transportation, and automation experience inside Minecraft.

It combines a wide range of Create addons that introduce complex machinery, logistics networks, fuel systems, cannons, aircraft, trains, and factory automation. Players can build massive industrial bases, fully automated factories, and advanced transportation systems using rails, hypertubes, drones, and planes.

The modpack also includes multiple performance and quality-of-life mods to ensure smooth gameplay even with heavy machinery, including FPS optimizations, UI improvements, and world navigation tools.

⚙️ Main Features
🏭 Engineering & Automation
Extensive Create mod expansion with many addons (factories, logistics, steam, diesel, and advanced machinery)
Automated production lines and complex mechanical systems
Advanced resource processing and factory building
🚆 Transportation & Logistics
Train systems with advanced navigation and mapping tools
Hypertubes and linked remote transport systems
Cargo delivery systems using Create logistics and drones
✈️ Vehicles & Combat
Aircraft and jetpacks for aerial movement
Big cannons and projectile systems
Mobile machinery and transport units
🧠 Quality of Life & UI
JEI recipe browser for crafting guidance
Jade tooltips and world info overlays
Xaero’s Minimap and World Map for navigation
Auto tools, auto respawn, zoom features
⚡ Performance Optimization
Sodium + Iris rendering improvements
Lithium performance optimizations
ImmediatelyFast for UI speed improvements
FastQuit for smoother exiting
🛡️ Utility & Survival Enhancements
SecurityCraft for base protection systems
WorldEdit for building assistance
Superflat customization improvements
Auto respawn and gameplay comfort mods
🎮 Gameplay Experience

This modpack is designed for players who enjoy:

Engineering and technical builds
Large factory automation systems
Transportation networks (trains, planes, logistics)
Creative problem-solving and optimization
A balanced mix of survival and technical gameplay

You can start small with simple machines and gradually scale up into massive industrial empires powered by fully automated systems.
